titleEn: Port Moody Whole-House Renovation 2026: Costs, Strata Rules & Neighbourhood Guide
titleZh: 满地宝2026全屋装修指南：费用、 strata 规定与社区详解
contentEn:
A whole-house renovation in Port Moody in 2026 costs $50,000 to $300,000 or more, depending on the scope and the age of your home. A cosmetic refresh of a 1,500–2,000 sq ft townhouse starts around $50,000. A mid-range full renovation of a 1970s–1990s single-family home typically runs $90,000–$180,000. A high-end whole-house rebuild with structural changes, custom cabinetry throughout, and premium finishes can exceed $300,000. These figures include BC building permits, $5M commercial general liability insurance, and a 3-year workmanship warranty from Reno Stars.

What Drives Whole-House Renovation Costs in Port Moody

Three factors most commonly push Port Moody whole-house quotes above baseline:

  • Strata governance — Port Moody's Newport Village, Fremont Village, and many 1990s–2000s townhouse complexes are strata-titled. Any work affecting common property, shared walls, plumbing risers, or structural elements requires written strata council approval before a contractor can legally start. This typically adds 2–4 weeks to project startup but rarely adds significant cost if your contractor prepares the documentation package correctly.
  • Age of housing stock — Port Moody's single-family homes on Heritage Mountain and in Ranch Park date from the 1970s through the 1990s. Many contain knob-and-tube electrical wiring, original galvanized plumbing, and asbestos in floor tile glue and pipe insulation (homes built before 1990). Asbestos testing and remediation alone can add $2,000–$15,000. Knob-and-tube replacement by a licensed electrician adds $4,000–$12,000 depending on home size.
  • Slope and drainage — Port Moody sits on varied terrain. Homes on Heritage Mountain and near Pitt Lake Road with moderate slope may require drainage correction or minor retaining structures, adding $2,000–$8,000 to site preparation.

Typical Whole-House Renovation Timelines in Port Moody

Duration depends on scope, permit requirements, and whether the home is strata-titled:

  • Townhouse cosmetic refresh: 8 – 14 weeks (strata approval adds 2 – 4 weeks to startup)
  • Mid-range single-family whole-house: 12 – 20 weeks
  • High-end with structural changes: 20 – 36 weeks
  • Adding a legal secondary suite: add 8 – 14 weeks to any of the above

Permits Required for Port Moody Whole-House Projects

Port Moody falls under City of Port Moody building permit jurisdiction. A whole-house renovation that involves any of the following requires a building permit: structural alterations, any plumbing work, electrical circuit additions, basement finishing, exterior envelope changes, or moving load-bearing walls. A cosmetic refresh with no plumbing or structural changes typically does not require a permit, but confirm with the City of Port Moody before starting. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of every full-scope project.

Port Moody Neighbourhoods for Whole-House Renovations

Port Moody's housing stock clusters in three areas with distinct renovation profiles:

  • Heritage Mountain — Larger single-family homes (2,000–3,500 sq ft) from the 1980s–1990s. Most popular for whole-house renovations. Many homeowners here are replacing original golden oak cabinetry, dated bathroom fixtures, and original electrical panels from the era. Reno Stars has completed multiple whole-house projects in Heritage Mountain.
  • Newport Village and Fremont Village — Townhouses and condos from the 1990s–2000s. Strata approval is required for any work affecting shared structure or plumbing. Compact kitchen and bathroom renovations in the $30,000–$60,000 range are most common here.
  • Ranch Park and Pleasantside — Established character homes from the 1950s–1970s. Good structural bones but often containing knob-and-tube wiring and original plumbing. Whole-house renovations here are typically $80,000–$160,000 and frequently include heritage-sensitive updates.

Frequently Asked Questions — Port Moody Whole-House Renovations

How much does a whole-house renovation cost in Port Moody in 2026?

A whole-house renovation in Port Moody starts at approximately $50,000 for a townhouse cosmetic refresh. A mid-range full renovation of a 1970s–1990s single-family home typically runs $90,000–$180,000. A high-end whole-house rebuild with custom finishes throughout starts at $180,000 and can exceed $300,000 depending on scope and structural changes. Adding a legal secondary suite adds approximately $130,000 to any of these figures.

Does a whole-house renovation in Port Moody require strata approval?

If your home is a townhouse or condo in a strata corporation, written approval from the strata council is required before any work that affects common property, shared walls, plumbing risers, or structural elements. Approval typically takes 2–4 weeks. Reno Stars prepares the full strata documentation package including scope of work, contractor insurance certificate, and noise management plan, and submits it on your behalf.

What permits does Port Moody require for whole-house work?

Port Moody requires a building permit for any whole-house renovation that involves structural changes, plumbing, electrical work, basement finishing, or changes to the exterior envelope. Cosmetic work with no structural, plumbing, or electrical changes typically does not require a permit, but verify with the City of Port Moody Building Division before starting. Reno Stars manages all permit applications as part of every full-scope project.

How long does a whole-house renovation take in Port Moody?

A townhouse cosmetic refresh takes 8–14 weeks including strata approval time. A mid-range single-family whole-house renovation takes 12–20 weeks. A high-end whole-house project with structural changes takes 20–36 weeks. Adding a legal secondary suite to any of these adds 8–14 weeks. Strata approval for townhouses and condos adds 2–4 weeks to the startup timeline before demolition begins.

Why are whole-house renovation costs higher in Port Moody than in newer cities?

Port Moody's 1970s–1990s housing stock frequently contains outdated electrical systems (knob-and-tube wiring), original galvanized plumbing, and asbestos in floor tile glue and pipe insulation — conditions not found in newer construction. Remediation brings your home up to current code and improves safety, but adds cost. Reno Stars includes a detailed pre-construction assessment in every proposal, identifying these conditions before you sign so there are no budget surprises after work begins.

满地宝（Port Moody）2026 年全屋装修费用从 $50,000 到 $300,000 以上不等，具体取决于房屋面积、房龄和装修范围。联排别墅表面装修起价约 $50,000。1970 至 1990 年代独立屋的中端全屋装修一般在 $90,000 至 $180,000 之间。含结构改建和全屋定制橱柜的高端全屋重建可超过 $300,000。Reno Stars 的报价包含 BC 建筑许可证、$5M 商业综合责任保险和 3 年工艺质保。

影响满地宝全屋装修费用的主要因素

满地宝全屋装修成本最常见的三项增加因素：

  • Strata 物业管理规定 — 满地宝的 Newport Village、Fremont Village 及许多 1990 至 2000 年代联排别墅均属 strata 物业。任何影响公共财产、共用墙、供水立管或结构构件的工程均需事先获得 strata 管委会书面批准。审批通常增加 2–4 周启动时间。
  • 房屋房龄 — Heritage Mountain 和 Ranch Park 的独立屋多建于 1970 至 1990 年代。很多含有老化电线（knob-and-tube）、原始镀锌水管以及石棉（1990 年前建造的房屋中常见）。石棉检测和处理增加 $2,000–$15,000。更换 knob-and-tube 电线增加 $4,000–$12,000。
  • 地形与排水 — Heritage Mountain 及 Pitt Lake Road 附近斜坡房屋可能需要做坡度修正或挡土结构，额外增加 $2,000–$8,000。

满地宝全屋装修费用明细

装修范围费用区间典型工期
联排别墅表面翻新$50,000 – $90,0008 – 14 周
独立屋中端全屋装修$90,000 – $180,00012 – 20 周
高端全屋重建$180,000 – $300,000+20 – 36 周
含合法套间改建另加 $130,000另加 8 – 14 周

满地宝全屋装修工期

工期取决于工程范围、许可证要求和房屋是否为 strata 物业：

  • 联排别墅表面翻新：8 – 14 周（含 strata 审批 2–4 周）
  • 独立屋中端全屋装修：12 – 20 周
  • 含结构改建高端工程：20 – 36 周
  • 改建合法次套间：以上任意基础上另加 8 – 14 周

满地宝全屋装修所需许可证

满地宝属满地宝市政府建筑许可管辖范围。凡涉及结构改建、管道工程、电路增设、地库装修、外墙改动或拆除承重墙的全屋装修均需申请建筑许可证。纯表面翻新（无管道、无结构、无电路改动）通常不需许可证，但开工前应向满地宝市政府建筑部门确认。Reno Stars 在每个全屋项目报价中包含全套许可证申请服务。

满地宝全屋装修热点社区

满地宝住宅主要集中在三个装修特征各异的区域：

  • Heritage Mountain — 1980–1990 年代大型独立屋（2,000–3,500 平方尺）。全屋装修最热门区域。很多业主正在更换该年代流行的金色橡木橱柜、过时浴室设备和老旧配电箱。
  • Newport Village 和 Fremont Village — 1990–2000 年代联排别墅和公寓。涉及共用结构或管道的工程需 strata 审批。此区域最常见 $30,000–$60,000 的紧凑型厨房和浴室装修。
  • Ranch Park 和 Pleasantside — 1950–1970 年代特色住宅。房屋结构优良，但常含 knob-and-tube 老化和原始管道。此区域全屋装修一般在 $80,000–$160,000 之间。

常见问题 — 满地宝全屋装修

满地宝全屋装修 2026 年费用是多少？

满地宝全屋装修起价约 $50,000（联排别墅表面翻新）。1970–1990 年代独立屋中端全屋装修一般在 $90,000–$180,000。含全屋定制饰面的高端全屋装修从 $180,000 起，根据工程范围可超过 $300,000。改建合法次套间在以上任意基础上另加约 $130,000。

满地宝全屋装修需要 strata 审批吗？

如果您的房屋属于 strata 联排别墅或公寓，任何影响公共财产、共用墙、供水立管或结构构件的工程均需获得 strata 管委会书面批准。审批通常需要 2–4 周。Reno Stars 准备全套 strata 文档包（含工程范围、承包商保险证明和噪音管理方案）并代为提交。

满地宝全屋装修需要哪些许可证？

满地宝对涉及结构改建、管道、电路、地库装修或外墙改动的全屋装修要求申请建筑许可证。纯表面翻新通常不需许可证，但开工前应向满地宝市政府建筑部门确认。Reno Stars 为每个全屋项目提供全套许可证申请服务。
